notes: Curated eval for the craft-pass output contract. Routing prompts stay on practitioner language; output checks require the skill's leading test, not a section list.

should_trigger.prompt: Please create seller-ready competitor battlecards with fit guidance, discovery questions, supported responses, proof, and escalation boundaries.
I need head-to-head compete guidance, competitive call preparation, buyer comparison handling, or a field-ready battlecard.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable battlecard and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please build and refine value propositions and messaging frameworks for revenue teams.
Please build a structured objection handling library from qualified objection evidence, with response patterns, proof, and escalation rules.
Please build concise, decision-ready account briefs for account reviews, account planning, renewal or expansion reviews, and customer meeting preparation.

output_structure_checks.name: battlecard-builder-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a fit map with win, lose, and qualify-out conditions, plus discovery questions before counters. Does not read as an attack sheet.

output_structure_checks.name: battlecard-builder-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.
